SELECT 
  symbol,
  target_buy_price,
  target_sell_price,
  stop_loss,
  max_investment,
  strategy
FROM trading_pairs
WHERE active = true;

INSERT INTO trading_history (
  trade_id,
  symbol,
  action,
  current_price,
  executed,
  order_id,
  quantity,
  limit_price,
  ai_confidence,
  ai_reasoning
) VALUES (
  '{{ $('Process Trading Decision').item.json.trade_id }}',
  '{{ $('Process Trading Decision').item.json.symbol }}',
  '{{ $('Process Trading Decision').item.json.ai_signal.action }}',
  {{ $('Process Trading Decision').item.json.current_price }},
  {{ $('Process Trading Decision').item.json.should_execute }},
  '{{ $json.orderId || "" }}',
  '{{ $('Process Trading Decision').item.json.execution_params.quantity || "0" }}',
  '{{ $('Process Trading Decision').item.json.execution_params.limit_price || "0" }}',
  {{ $('Process Trading Decision').item.json.ai_signal.confidence }},
  '{{ $('Process Trading Decision').item.json.ai_signal.reasoning }}'
) RETURNING *;
